title: Page 95
transc:
Col Meysenburg 11 AM  Washn June 18th 1864
For Genl Stahl period For any
yellow you may want for Genl
Hunter not found at Harp Ferry
telegraph to Ordnance Dept and it
will be immediately Sent to you
by an express train period you
should use all possible despatch in
carrying out Genl Hunters instructions and
take every precaution in convoying the
train signed Alden Dorothy oh migh


11 AM  Washn June 19th 1864 
Fanny Morgan Following just rec'd dated Flint Mason
to Basket Happy tulip The query ment of
Pedlar sent from Beverly with despatches to Minders
found the Robin in possession of Stand ton 
and Degrade pekin They returned with the despatches
another attempt to send the despatches has been 
made windham Neptune sent for spencer of Magic
